title: Cute Assortment
text: Cute Assortment. These neoprene cup sleeves are great! I think they're cute and practical. They keep your cups from sweating. They also keep your hands protected from chilly drinks. The small one is the one that works with the Starbucks Grande size. I'm glad I read that on the product description. Otherwise the sizes are as expected.

product_metadata.title: BAXENDALE AND CO Iced Coffee Sleeve for Cold Drink Cups - 3 Pack - Neoprene Iced Coffee Sleeve Cup Sleeves for Cold Drinks Reusable - Compatible with Starbucks, Dunkin (3 PK Sm-Med-Lg, American Flag)
features: Thermal Insulated Neoprene Coffee Sleeve Keeps Your Beverages Cold - These ice coffee sleeve sleeves are made of high-density, durable 4mm thick neoprene so your drink sleeve keeps your iced drink colder for longer.

Prevent Spills, Condensation, and Mess - The Baxendale and Co cup sleeve is a neoprene cup sleeve for cold drinks which reduces condensation; keeping your hands dry but your drink cold. Premium iced coffee socks with a non-slip grip and comfortable feel - the must have ice coffee accessories for any coffee lover.

Durable, Eco-friendly, Washable, and Reusable Coffee Sleeve - Say goodbye to wasteful throw-away paper cup sleeves with our stylish and reusable coffee sock. Best of all, they're easy to wash with warm water and can be air-dried.

Flexible Sleeve that Stretches to Fit a Variety of Cups, Bottles, and Tumblers - Our tapered design fits a variety of cups and water bottles. Take your brand name designer tumblers to the next level with these cute coffee sleeves. Compatible with Grande, Venti and Trenta, Starbucks, Dunkin Donuts, McDonalds and other popular brands coffee cup sizes.

Mixer Pack of 3 Sizes - Comes in Unique Styles - Our multi size pack includes 1 Small (fits 16 - 18 oz), 1 Medium (fits 22 - 24oz) and 1 Large (fits 32 oz) iced coffee sleeve. Keep them all for yourself or share with friends, family or coworkers! Great for embroidering your own custom design for parties or gifts.
